discrete.source: UP Baguio CMSC 55 Discrete Mathematical Structures in Computer Science (public syllabus)
topics: Propositions; logical connectives; rules of inference; laws of equivalence; truth tables; proof by contradiction; resolution
Set operations; algebra of sets; relations; ordering and equivalence relations; partitions; functions; composition and inversion
Rules of sum and product; counting models; combinatorial identities; generating functions; recurrence relations; inclusion-exclusion
Axioms of probability; finite sample spaces; conditional probability and independence; random variables and discrete distributions
Isomorphism and homomorphism; planarity; shortest path; minimum spanning tree; travelling salesman; matching; colorability
Groups, groupoids and semigroups; homomorphism and isomorphism; application in coding theory
